verdict.rationale: The official repo documents an in-agent marketplace flow: `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, then `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills` (gh-1, gh-4, docs-9, docs-71). A recorded hands-on probe also installed a skill with an `npx -y skills add anthropics/skills` one-liner into `.claude/skills/`, which Claude Code discovers automatically (docs-1). Missing for 10: the official path takes two commands (register marketplace, then install), not one; the npx one-liner is third-party tooling, not documented by Anthropic; and no evidence directly confirms the skills are active in the next session after install.
